summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the exchange of remaining senior convertible notes for a warrant to purchase 1,125,000 shares at an initial exercise price of $8.00 per share, along with a partial redemption for approximately $3.18 million and a press release about a global publishing rights MOU. The exchange was done under Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act. This is a routine debt-for-equity restructuring and business development update, not a transformative special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No special-situation event triggered the filing.
